question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Indispensable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Imperative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indispensable **means absolutely necessary or essential. (नितांत आवश्यक)

 
 
• **Example**: *His expertise in data analysis proved indispensable to the success of the research project.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Imperative **is a synonym of indispensable, meaning crucial or vital. (निर्णायक या महत्वपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *Proper training is imperative for new employees.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Destructive **means causing harm or damage. (हानि या क्षति पहुँचाना)
 
• **Drastic **means extreme or severe. (अत्यधिक या गंभीर)
 
• **Invariable **means never changing or constant. (कभी बदलने वाला या स्थिर नहीं)
